name: commit
title: Commit
description: A compact commit card with avatar, message, short hash, author and relative time, plus a copy button; clicking the header reveals each changed file with an A/M/D/R status and green or red line counts.
use: A changelog, agent transcript or activity feed needs to show one code change with its files and line totals.
avoid: Full diff review: it lists file names and totals only, with no patch content to inspect.
a11y: The header toggles from the keyboard, but the icon-only copy button and the single-letter file statuses lack text labels. (keyboard: yes, labels: partial, reduced motion: not handled)
looks: A dark rounded card. The top row pairs a round MC avatar with a bold message line and a smaller line holding a commit glyph, short hash, author and time, with a copy icon at the right. Below a divider, five file rows each show a coloured status letter, file icon, monospace path and green plus or red minus counts.
behaves: The header acts as a button that collapses or expands the file list, dimming slightly on hover. Rows tint under the pointer, and the copy icon swaps to a tick for a moment after the hash is copied.
customise: Assemble the card from exported parts: header, avatar initials, message, hash, timestamp, copy button and per-file rows; most inner pieces accept class names and standard element props.
weight: light: A collapsible list of five rows and a clipboard call; no animation loop.
